Include the 76 named galaxy-map recoveries. Recovery and subsequent quest delivery are distinct actions.

Include codex pages as checks: each page a conversation or mission unlocks after the start (variants of one
page are one check). Some come from optional conversations, so codex checks never hold progression items.

Progressive war-asset checks: "War Asset 1" up to this number. Each war asset or upgrade you gain (any of them,
whichever choices you make) moves you one step up the list. Galaxy-map recoveries have their own checks and don't
count here. 0 turns these off. These checks never hold progression items.
D5: start with only the M3 Predator; every other loadout weapon is an item in the pool.

Side missions (Grissom Academy, the Monastery, Jacob's scientists, Attican Traverse, the N7 missions, Eden Prime,
Omega) open on the galaxy map when their "Mission Access" item arrives, in any order, instead of following the story.
The Krogan arc (Palaven, Sur'Kesh, Tuchanka) and the Geth arc (Dreadnought, Rannoch) need "Story Arc" items too;
the arcs keep their story order. Off: everything follows the story as usual.

Missed-checks salvage: once you've been on a mission that can't be replayed, the Normandy's store terminal sells
"<mission> Salvage". Each purchase sends one check you left behind on that mission.
Include mapped pickup sources in the selected official DLC campaigns.
